question_details.title: Will Iran allow the IAEA to inspect its stockpile of enriched uranium before 2026?
question_details.description:
A [brief, 12-day war](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iran%E2%80%93Israel_war) between Iran and Israel in June 2025 ended when American B-2 bombers dropped several [GBU-57](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GBU-57A/B_MOP) 30,000-pound bunker-buster bombs on Iran's nuclear facilities in Natanz, Fordow, and Isfahan.
